"True Kin" from "Kin" the two characters may send messages (as per improved message the neuronic skill, but it is not neuronic in nature between each other at the cost of 3 tblp per use.

desc: Magical Scholar: May now read and utilise magical scrolls with skill level based on the Scholar multiclass. Not available those in the Priest bracket. User must be able to utilise magic etc.
